question: Why do some worship taste itself as the cause of the lord of gods' satisfaction?
premises: Some worshippers take taste as their object.
They regard it as causing satisfaction to the lord of gods.
This worship is expressed with wonder.
inference: Divine satisfaction may be approached through the worship of taste.
uncertainties: Whether ruci refers to aesthetic relish, appetite, or spiritual inclination is ambiguous.
plain_english: Alas, some worship taste itself, considering it the cause of satisfaction for the mouth of the lord of gods.
